blocking: The painted trunks are sliced by a hard horizontal edge where .descend ends (desktop-1 at ~y630, phone-1 top-left brown sliver): the tree art looks like a cropped rectangle, not a tree that frames the page.

fixes.what: Add `.descend__trunks::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:180px;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,rgba(27,34,30,0),var(--night));pointer-events:none}` so the strips dissolve into cypress before the section boundary cuts them.
fixes.why: A flat cut line through painted art reads as a layout bug and breaks the 'tree frames the edges' idea.
On the phone the uppercase tagline sits directly over pale roses (phone-0); the logo is safe, the line is not.

fixes.what: In the #inquire IntersectionObserver also toggle `header.classList.toggle('is-at-inquire', inquireInView)`; CSS: `.site-header.is-at-inquire .btn--sm{background:transparent;color:var(--parch)}`.
fixes.why: Desktop-4 shows two gold-filled buttons on one screen (header Inquire + Begin the conversation), against the brand's own one-gold-button rule.
Nine columns at 1140px with 13px notes feel cramped and diagrammatic (desktop-3); Persian in stone here contradicts the gold Persian used everywhere else.

fixes.what: Add `.journey{padding-top:clamp(40px,7vh,88px)}` and drop the negative margin on .journey__order to a plain `margin:0 auto clamp(32px,6vh,72px)`.
fixes.why: Desktop-3 has ~200px of dead space (deep band then night) between the teaser and 'The journey'; the rhythm sags.

fixes.what: Replace the Georgia ⏸/▶ glyphs with an inline SVG background (two 2px gold bars / a gold triangle) via `background-image` and remove the `font-family` line.
fixes.why: Georgia is the only non-brand Latin face on the site, and a system symbol glyph renders differently per OS.
